# Documentation Improvement

## Context

Which part of the documentation is unclear or missing?

## Expected Behavior

What should the documentation help users do?

## Actual Behavior

What is confusing, incomplete, stale, or hard to find?

## Files Involved

List repository paths.

## Agent Or Tool Used

Name the agent, CLI, script, or workflow if relevant.

## Validation Evidence

How should the docs change be validated?

## Governance Impact

Does this affect governance, validation, traceability, review policy,
source-of-truth files, hooks, or agent operating rules?
